Your privacy matters to us, so you can disable certain types of storage that may not be necessary for the website to function. Blocking some categories may affect your experience on the website.

They may also be used to limit how often you see an ad and to measure the effectiveness of advertising campaigns. Advertising networks usually place them with the website operator's permission.
CookieBanner.personalizationDesc: These items allow the website to remember your choices, such as your account name, language, or region, and provide features tailored to your preferences.

ProcessPopup.title: Maybe you do not need an immediate answer, but a clearer sense of what drives you.
ProcessPopup.description: Exploring your career anchors can help you recognize the motivations behind your decisions and better understand what matters at this stage.

Hero.slide0Description: Artificial intelligence has transformed the job market. Feeling uncertain is natural. We help you discover your next professional step with clarity, care, and a proven methodology.
Hero.slide1Description: Whether you have 5 or 20 years of experience, we design a clear plan together so your next step is strategic, not improvised. No judgment, at your own pace.

Trust.caption: Real stories
Trust.title: Professionals who found their direction
Trust.testimonial0Quote: I had spent months unsure where to go. The assessment gave me a clear map of my strengths and a practical plan. Today, I'm in a role I truly enjoy.
Trust.testimonial1Quote: AI made me feel as though my 15 years of experience no longer mattered. This process helped me translate that entire journey into the language of today's market.
Trust.testimonial2Quote: I didn't know whether to start a business or look for a job. I needed someone to help me think clearly, without pressure. That's what I found here.

Problem.title: Does this feel familiar?
Problem.description: You do not have to navigate this moment without support. Many people experience the same uncertainty. A thoughtful, supportive space can help you consider your next step with clarity.
Problem.descriptionP2: Making room for change is the best way to build something real. Every process is unique, and we support you as you move through yours.
Problem.situation0Desc: What worked yesterday is no longer enough. New tools, disappearing roles, and transforming industries. It is natural to wonder: how can I adapt without losing what I have built?
Problem.situation1Title: You don't know where to begin
Problem.situation1Desc: There are too many options and too little time to pause and think. Remote work, freelancing, entrepreneurship, changing careers... Uncertainty can be paralyzing, but standing still is not the answer.
Problem.situation2Desc: You may feel that your years of experience carry less weight in this new landscape. The truth is that your experience is your greatest asset — you simply need a bridge to what comes next.

Method.caption: Our Approach
Method.title: Your Transition Path
Method.step0Desc: We take the time to listen. We explore your journey, your talents, what truly matters to you, and what no longer represents you. The goal is for your next move to come from an authentic place.
Method.step1Desc: We connect your profile with real opportunities in today's market. Together, we map roles, sectors, and learning paths aligned with what we discovered in the first stage.
Method.step2Desc: This is where everything comes together. You receive a personalized report that integrates your strengths, interests, and areas for growth. It gives you what you need to make confident decisions grounded in real information about yourself.
Method.step3Title: Prepare to step into the world
Method.step3Desc: With your plan in hand, we equip you with everything you need to position yourself: a strategic résumé, interview preparation, and the tools to take your next step with confidence.

Paths.title: 5 Possible Paths.
Paths.subtitle: No two journeys are alike. We design the strategy around where you are now and where you want to go.
Paths.path0Desc: For those looking to return quickly to a similar role. We refine your professional narrative and positioning to shorten your job search.
Paths.path1Desc: If you feel that new tools have left you behind, we help you close the gap and regain your competitive edge in today's market.
Paths.path2Desc: For leaders and managers aiming for C-level roles or strategic consulting. We transform your narrative from execution-focused to business-oriented.
Paths.path3Desc: You want to shift industries or functions but do not know how. We design a plan to carry your strengths into an entirely new field.
Paths.path4Desc: Move from employment to a venture of your own. We validate your business idea through a controlled-risk structure and clear steps.

Services.title: Your next step can begin today.
Services.description: Your first assessment is free. Discover your career anchors and receive a personalized report to begin shaping your next chapter with clarity.

FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtitle: Clarity comes first.
FAQ.q1Answer: It is for anyone experiencing a professional transition or uncertainty. You may have lost your job, seen AI transform your industry, want to change direction, or simply feel that the time has come for something new.
FAQ.q2Question: How long does the process take?
FAQ.q2Answer: The assessment is immediate and free. The full support program typically takes between 4 and 8 weeks, depending on your pace and goals.
FAQ.q3Question: What if I don't know what I want to do?
FAQ.q3Answer: That is exactly the right moment to begin. Our assessment is designed to help you uncover patterns in your interests, strengths, and values that you may not yet see. You do not need to arrive with answers, only a willingness to explore.
FAQ.q4Question: Is it online or in person?
FAQ.q4Answer: It is 100% online, so you can join from anywhere in the world. Every session retains the closeness and warmth of human support.

About.heroDescription: A multidisciplinary team that believes in people and their capacity to reinvent themselves — at any age and at any point in life.
About.missionText: Senda was created to offer a space where people can consider their professional future with calm, clarity, and specialized guidance. In a world where artificial intelligence has transformed the rules of the market, we believe that self-awareness and strategy can help each person find a place of their own.
About.whatWeDoSubtitle: We combine three pillars to support your professional transition.
About.pillarPsychometricDesc: Guidance tools based on recognized models to explore interests, aptitudes, and values.
About.pillarHumanDesc: A team experienced in talent and career strategy that listens, guides, and helps you make informed decisions.
About.pillarAiDesc: We use AI as a supporting tool to analyze trends, personalize recommendations, and strengthen your process — always with human oversight.
About.valueWarmthDesc: Every person who comes to us brings a unique story. We listen with empathy, without judgment, and build from there.
About.valueRigorDesc: We use recognized models, a structured methodology, and artificial intelligence as a complement, never as a replacement for human judgment.
About.valueClarityDesc: We do not sell illusions. We help you see your situation honestly so you can make informed, strategic decisions.
About.valueSupportDesc: You are not a number. Every process is personal, unfolds at your pace, and includes a team that remains present throughout the transition.
About.ctaTitle: Ready to begin finding your direction?
About.ctaDescription: You can begin by putting into words what is changing. The initial diagnostic helps us guide you toward a possible journey.

VocationalGuidance.heroDescription: Whether you are 18 or 50, this process is for you if you are facing a transition, feeling uncertain, or simply sense that it is time for a change.
VocationalGuidance.introTitle: Not knowing what you want to do is more common than you may think.
VocationalGuidance.introText: Vocational and career guidance is a learning process for people of all ages. It is about understanding yourself, identifying your life goals, and finding professional options that truly represent you — especially in a market transformed by artificial intelligence.
VocationalGuidance.benefitDirectionDesc: Through in-depth exploration activities, we identify what motivates you, what you care about, and where you want to go. Your age and starting point do not matter.
VocationalGuidance.benefitStrengthsDesc: Using guidance tools and in-depth conversations, we map your abilities, values, and interests so you can make decisions based on concrete information.
VocationalGuidance.benefitDesignDesc: Once you have clarity about who you are and what you want, we build a realistic action plan together: from what to study to how to position yourself in the job market.
VocationalGuidance.midCtaTitle: Finding your direction begins with a decision.
VocationalGuidance.midCtaText: This process helps you think, reflect, and find answers. We guide you toward discovering your true vocation so you can pursue something that motivates you and that you enjoy.
VocationalGuidance.processSubtitle: 8 individual sessions of 60 to 90 minutes, at your own pace (weekly or every other week). 100% online, wherever you are.
VocationalGuidance.session01Title: Your story and where you are now
VocationalGuidance.session01Desc: We begin by exploring your journey, your current situation, and what brought you here. We listen without judgment to understand your context in depth.
VocationalGuidance.session02Desc: We explore your personality, resources, learning styles, and coping strategies. Self-awareness is the foundation of the entire process.
VocationalGuidance.session03Desc: We look closely at what drives you: the activities you enjoy, the environments where you feel comfortable, and the kinds of challenges that energize you.
VocationalGuidance.session04Desc: We connect everything we have learned with professional fields and areas for growth. We begin shaping the options that resonate with your profile.
VocationalGuidance.session05Desc: We narrow down the options and research them thoroughly: curricula, career fields, future prospects, and the real market in your area.
VocationalGuidance.session06Desc: We analyze roles, routes into employment, and current market trends — including the impact of AI — so your decision is grounded in today's reality.
VocationalGuidance.session07Desc: We bring everything together into a practical plan: what to do, where to begin, what to study, and how to position yourself. It is your personalized roadmap.
VocationalGuidance.session08Desc: You receive a comprehensive report with your strengths profile, interests, recommendations, and next steps. You leave with clarity and direction.
VocationalGuidance.reportDescription: At the end of the process, you receive a complete report that brings together everything we explored. It is your compass for making decisions with confidence.
VocationalGuidance.reportNote: When we present the report, we answer questions, explore any concerns, and can include guidance on preparing your résumé.
VocationalGuidance.audienceYoungDesc: You finished high school and do not know what to study. Or you started a degree and feel it is not right for you. This is your space to think without pressure.
VocationalGuidance.audienceProfessionalsDesc: You have worked for years, but something does not fit. Perhaps AI transformed your industry, or you simply want a change. It is time to reconsider your direction.
VocationalGuidance.audienceLeadersDesc: You have a wealth of experience but feel you need a change. You may want to pivot to another sector, start a business, or aim for a C-level role.
VocationalGuidance.audienceTransitionDesc: You lost your job, automation changed your role, or you are at a turning point. Whatever your age, this process gives you clarity.
VocationalGuidance.finalCtaText: Begin your vocational guidance process with specialized support and validated tools. 100% online.
VocationalGuidance.finalCtaButton: I want to begin my process

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.section1Text: At Senda, we collect the information you provide when using our services: your name, email address, professional information, assessment answers and results, submitted inquiries, and technical data essential to security and operation.
Privacy.section2Text: We use this information to provide requested services, save your result, answer inquiries, protect and improve the platform, and comply with legal obligations. Informational communications require your consent, and you can unsubscribe from them.
Privacy.section3Text: We apply authentication controls, database permissions, server-side validation, protection against abusive automation, and encrypted communications. No system offers absolute security, but we limit access and collection to what is necessary to operate the service.
Privacy.section4Text: The free assessment provides guidance rather than a clinical diagnosis. To generate and save it, the necessary answers and work-related details may be processed by infrastructure, database, security, and artificial-intelligence providers under our instructions. We do not send your name, email, phone number, or address to the model. Access is limited to team members who need the information to provide a requested service or respond to an inquiry.
Privacy.section5Text: We use essential cookies for authentication, security, and preferences. If non-essential technologies are introduced, they must respect the choice presented on the site.
Privacy.section6Text: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your data, withdraw consent, and ask how your information is handled. We retain information for as long as needed to provide the service and meet applicable obligations.
Privacy.section7Text: For questions about this policy, email us at <email>contacto@senda.com</email>.

Terms.title: Terms and Conditions
Terms.section1Text: Senda is a vocational guidance and career strategy platform. Its services include assessments, self-awareness tools, and individual guidance sessions.
Terms.section2Text: You must create an account and provide accurate, up-to-date information to access certain services. You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential and protecting access to your account.
Terms.section3Text: Vocational assessments are guidance tools. Their results invite reflection and can be complemented by an individual conversation; they are not fixed definitions and do not determine career decisions.
Terms.section4Text: Before a journey begins, Senda privately and clearly communicates its engagement terms and available payment methods. No process is confirmed without explicit acceptance of those terms.
Terms.section5Text: Sessions may be canceled or rescheduled at least 24 hours in advance at no cost. Cancellations made less than 24 hours in advance are nonrefundable. Session packages are nonrefundable once the process has begun.
Terms.section6Text: All platform content, including text, designs, methodology, assessments, and session materials, is the property of Senda and is protected by intellectual property laws. Reproduction without express authorization is prohibited.
Terms.section7Text: Senda does not guarantee specific results from using its services. Our role is to provide tools, information, and guidance for each transition. Career decisions remain the responsibility of each individual.
Terms.section8Text: For questions about these terms, email us at <email>contacto@senda.com</email>.

CareerQuiz.metadataDescription: Discover your career anchor through Edgar Schein's model. A free interpretation to help you understand your journey and guide your next steps.
CareerQuiz.introTitle: Your career GPS: explore what drives you at work
CareerQuiz.introSubtitle: An inner compass for understanding your journey more clearly.
CareerQuiz.introParagraph1: Edgar Schein developed this model to explore the combination of abilities, motivations, and values that a person seeks to preserve throughout their working life.
CareerQuiz.introParagraph2: Your career anchor is the unique combination of abilities, motivations, and values that you would not easily give up. Understanding it can help you make choices that are more consistent with who you are and recognize what you need to protect during a time of change.
CareerQuiz.questionsScaleDesc: Answer each question using the scale from 1 (Never) to 6 (Always)
CareerQuiz.transitionTitle: One last step — your result is almost ready!
CareerQuiz.transitionSubtitle: There is one final choice to help identify which aspects are truly nonnegotiable for you.
CareerQuiz.transitionInstruction: You'll review all 40 statements again. This time, choose the 3 that best represent what you need to preserve in your professional life, even as your role or context changes.
CareerQuiz.transitionNote: Your final three choices will carry additional weight in the calculation, helping us identify your primary anchor more clearly.
CareerQuiz.bonusSubtitle: Choose only 3 statements in total. You can review every group before confirming.
CareerQuiz.bonusInstruction: Choose the 3 statements that matter most to you
CareerQuiz.prequizSubtitle: To prepare an initial interpretation of your Dominant Anchor, we need some basic information about your current context.
CareerQuiz.resultsScheinQuote: A career anchor brings together the abilities, motivations, and values that a person seeks to preserve throughout their professional journey. — A summary of Edgar Schein's model
CareerQuiz.resultsDominantText: Because your dominant anchor is {article} {name}, any professional move should protect this central part of your profile. Treat it as a starting point for reflection, not a fixed definition. If you'd like to explore it further, you can ask our team for guidance.

manifesto.first: We do not believe a person is their résumé. Nor do we believe one choice determines an entire life. We believe careers can be revisited, stories can be read differently, and paths can be built again.

faq.title: Before you begin.
faq.intro: A few answers to help you understand what a Senda journey feels like.

which.question: How do I know which process I need?
which.answer: You don't need to know in advance. The initial diagnostic helps us understand your moment, organize the question, and identify which journey may support you best.

switch.question: What if I begin one process and discover I need another?
switch.answer: The journeys are not rigid compartments. If another need emerges, we revisit the direction and agree on the most suitable way forward.

format.question: Are meetings virtual or in person?
format.answer: Meetings take place virtually, so you can sustain the process wherever you are. If an in-person alternative is available for your case, it will be discussed before you begin.

duration.question: How long does each process take?
duration.answer: Vocational guidance includes 6 individual meetings. Professional reinvention and career transition include 8 meetings each.

single.question: Can I book a single session?
single.answer: Senda works through complete journeys because change requires time, continuity, and integration. The initial diagnostic helps determine whether this is the right moment and process for you.

diagnostic.question: How does the initial diagnostic work?
diagnostic.answer: It is a brief, non-clinical form about your situation, what you need, your current stage, and the urgency of the change. The team receives this information to guide you toward the most suitable journey.

receive.question: What will I receive at the end?
receive.answer: Each process closes with a personalized synthesis, practical tools, and a roadmap. The specific deliverables depend on your journey.

final.title: Your path does not need to be completely clear before you begin.
final.description: You can start by putting into words what is changing. The rest is built step by step.

journey.title: Step by step.
journey.note: Every stage adapts to the person's actual moment; the sequence is a guide, not a rigid formula.

cta.title: You can begin without having the answer.
cta.description: The initial diagnostic helps us understand your moment and guide you with clarity, care, and no pressure.

orientation.title: Vocational guidance
orientation.lead: When you need to choose—or choose again—a path.
orientation.cardDescription: Explore interests, experiences, possibilities, and directions to build a choice that is your own, grounded, and meaningful.
orientation.metaDescription: A vocational guidance journey to explore interests, possibilities, and meaningful next steps.
orientation.intro: A process for people who need to better understand what interests them, what they want to build, and which study or work paths may make sense at this stage.
orientation.clarification: It does not provide a closed answer about the ‘right career.’ It supports a deep exploration toward choices that are more personal, informed, and possible.

name.title: Name the question
name.description: We begin by putting the current moment into words: doubts, expectations, educational history, earlier experiences, outside pressures, and unanswered questions.

interests.title: Recognize meaningful interests and experiences
interests.description: We explore interests, motivations, energizing activities, relevant experiences, and personal ways of learning, working, and relating to knowledge.

desires.title: Understand desires, values, and constraints
desires.description: We work with desires, skills, values, fears, family or social expectations, and the concrete conditions that shape a choice.

possibilities.title: Explore possibilities
possibilities.description: We research study options, occupations, professional fields, ways of working, and possible lifestyles, connecting real alternatives with the person's journey.

validate.title: Build hypotheses and test paths
validate.description: Instead of choosing in the abstract, we build path hypotheses and small validation experiences: research, conversations, new environments, and trial activities.

integrate.title: Integrate and decide next steps
integrate.description: The process closes with an integrated reflection, prioritized alternatives, and a 90-day exploration or decision plan.

reinvention.title: Professional reinvention
reinvention.lead: When your degree, career, or professional role no longer represents you.
reinvention.cardDescription: Recognize what is ending, what remains valuable, and which new direction you can build.
reinvention.metaDescription: A journey to understand your career, redesign your professional identity, and build a new direction.
reinvention.intro: A process for people who feel their work, career, degree, or current role no longer expresses who they are or where they want to go.
reinvention.clarification: This is not about erasing your history and starting over. It is about understanding what you have built, recovering what still matters, and designing a new stage with direction.

moment.title: Read the moment of change
moment.description: We begin by understanding what has run its course, what was lost, which desire for change emerged, what conditions exist, and which questions need an answer.

identity.title: Revisit professional identity
identity.description: We explore the place work has held in your life, which parts of your professional identity remain current, and which no longer represent you.

patterns.title: Recognize patterns, resources, and limits
patterns.description: We identify strengths, motivations, choice patterns, discomforts, fears, available resources, and personal factors that need care during change.

criteria.title: Build criteria for choosing
criteria.description: We integrate desires, possibilities, and real limits to assess new scenarios without repeating paths that no longer make sense.

direction.title: Turn clarity into direction
direction.description: Exploration becomes a concrete hypothesis: reshape your current role, change industries, take on another function, build a venture, or combine paths.

futures.title: Design possible futures
futures.description: We work with scenarios, alternatives, priorities, and decisions to identify which futures can begin to be built.

movement.title: Create a movement plan
movement.description: We define actions, conversations, experiments, networks, habits, and commitments that bring change into practice.

integrate.title: Integrate the journey
integrate.description: The process closes with a new professional narrative, a prioritized direction, and a 30-, 60-, and 90-day roadmap.

takeaways.strengths: A reading of strengths, patterns, and motivators.

transition.title: Career transition
transition.lead: When change is already happening and you need to turn it into movement.
transition.cardDescription: Organize your strategy, activate your search or repositioning, and make your chosen direction visible.
transition.metaDescription: A journey to organize a career transition, define your objective, and turn it into a visible strategy.
transition.intro: A process for people already moving through a concrete career change: a departure, a search, a promotion, a company change, a return to the market, or a need to reposition.
transition.clarification: Here, the focus is moving from uncertainty to a clear and visible strategy.

understand.title: Understand the transition
understand.description: We organize the current moment: employment situation, urgency, experience, needs, context, objective, and the kind of change to navigate.

objective.title: Define the objective
objective.description: We build a clear direction: the kind of role, organization, project, or work scenario to pursue; what to leave behind and what to prioritize.

movement.title: Organize movement
movement.description: We create an action strategy: priorities, weekly goals, network, necessary conversations, active search, or preparation for change.

execution.title: Sustain execution
execution.description: We review progress, obstacles, and decisions, working on focus and the ability to adjust strategy without losing direction.

positioning.title: Build positioning
positioning.description: We translate experience into a clear value proposition: what the person contributes, how they tell their story, and what makes them distinctive.

presence.title: Organize professional presence
presence.description: We redesign the assets needed to show that direction: professional profile, résumé, LinkedIn, and presentation materials.

exposure.title: Prepare for visibility
exposure.description: We work on conversations, networking, interviews, professional pitch, and a presence aligned with the chosen objective.

continue.title: Integrate and continue
continue.description: The process closes with a continuity strategy, clear priorities, and a 90-day action plan.

takeaways.assets: A repositioned résumé and LinkedIn profile.

meta.title: Initial diagnostic
meta.description: A brief first step to understand the change you are going through and identify which journey may support you.

InitialDiagnostic.title: Let's put into words what is changing.
InitialDiagnostic.description: You don't need to know which process you need. These questions help us understand your moment and guide you more clearly.
InitialDiagnostic.disclaimer: This is a non-clinical guidance tool. It does not replace a professional assessment or diagnosis.

questions.situation: Which situation best describes your current moment?

situation.choosing: I am choosing what to study or where to direct myself.
situation.reinvention: My work or career no longer represents me.
situation.transition: I am going through a concrete career change.
situation.clarity: I don't know exactly what is happening, but I need clarity.

urgency.soon: I want to start moving soon.
urgency.decision: I need to decide in the short term.
urgency.urgent: I am going through an urgent situation.

InitialDiagnostic.contactNote: We will use this information only to respond to this diagnostic and guide the next step.
InitialDiagnostic.consent: I have read and accept the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.
InitialDiagnostic.privacyNote: Your answers are stored securely and are not used for unsolicited communications.

errors.name: Enter your name.
errors.consent: We need your consent to save this information.
errors.captcha: We couldn't verify this submission. Please try again.
errors.submit: We couldn't save your diagnostic right now. Please try again in a few minutes.

success.title: Thank you for sharing your moment.
success.description: We received your information and will guide you toward the Senda journey that may support you best.
